name: EGS Fly Cart Popup
author: eGrove Systems

sections.description:
EGS Fly Cart Popup adds a floating cart at the top-right of WooCommerce stores. The free plugin is fully functional and has no license checks, trials, quotas, or locked built-in controls.

Free features:

  • Floating cart at the top-right
  • Four selectable bundled cart icons
  • Adjustable icon size
  • Adjustable cart text size
  • Product image, name, quantity, and price
  • AJAX quantity updates and item removal
  • View Cart and Continue Shopping actions
  • Responsive layout

A separately distributed Pro add-on is available from Module Bazaar. The Pro add-on is not included in this WordPress.org plugin and adds custom icon uploads, shape customization, popup background colors, coupon controls, font choices, and additional cart positions.

Purchase Pro: https://plugins.modulebazaar.com/product/fly-cart/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate EGS Fly Cart Popup.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open Fly Cart in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin require a license?

No. Every feature included in this plugin is available without a license, payment, trial, quota, or expiration.

Where are the Pro features?

They are implemented in a separate Pro add-on distributed outside WordPress.org. No Pro implementation is bundled with this free plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Rebuilt front-end rendering to use wp_footer instead of wp_head.
  • Consolidated all scripts and styles through WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Added nonce verification to every cart AJAX request.
  • Removed duplicate AJAX callbacks and obsolete code.
  • Improved sanitization, escaping, translations, and WooCommerce dependency handling.
  • Fixed the translator comment for the numbered cart icon label.

1.5.0

  • Removed all license and trialware functionality.
  • Removed Pro feature implementations from the WordPress.org plugin.
  • Kept the free top-right cart, four bundled icons, icon sizing, text sizing, and core AJAX cart features.
  • Added an informational Pro page linking to the separately distributed add-on.
